parent_domains.justification: "Neural audio editing" involves various techniques and methods by which neural networks manipulate audio signals, which falls under the broader category of "audio processing."
This domain is a specific subset focusing on the processing of audio signals, which inherently includes editing capabilities. Thus, it is a parent of "neural audio editing."

closest_parent_domain.justification: "Audio processing" is a broader area concerned with the manipulation of audio signals in general, which encompasses the specific task of audio editing. This makes "audio processing" the most semantically similar parent domain.

closest_child_domain.justification: There are no child domains listed under "neural audio editing" from the Given List.

sibling_domains.justification: Both "generative models for audio" and "neural audio editing" focus on transforming and generating new audio data, making them siblings under the domain of "audio processing."
"Audio classification" is closely related as it involves analyzing and categorizing audio, which can be part of the audio manipulation chain just like editing.
"Speech synthesis" involves generating human speech and can be considered a sibling to neural editing that focuses on manipulating existing speech/audio data.
This domain deals with converting audio details into another form — typically symbolic data, akin to neural editing which also manipulates audio signals.
This area focuses on improving audio signals, much like neural audio editing which could include the enhancement of audio quality as part of its processes.
This specific branch of signal processing is a sibling to "neural audio editing" as it focuses on audio manipulation and function.
This domain encompasses various tasks related to manipulating and analyzing speech, akin to "neural audio editing."

closest_sibling_domain.justification: "Generative models for audio" shares a strong focus on using neural networks to creatively form or edit audio content, much like "neural audio editing."

unrelated_domains.justification: "Video synthesis" focuses on visual data, which is distinct from audio data manipulation involved in audio editing.
